system_health.degraded_when: all integrity requirements pass but one or more non-integrity operational checks are degraded
system_health.unusable_when: pipeline/publication/required artifact validation, provenance integrity, or freshness integrity fails

product_usefulness.unusable_when: integrity fails or degraded minimum content is not met
product_usefulness.missing_declared_asset_class_behavior: preserve explicit limitation and cap overall state at degraded
counting_rules: do not count stale, unavailable, unknown, or unverified closes
macro indicators do not count as core assets
verified_latest_session_close does not count until a separately reviewed policy is enabled

overall_aggregation.healthy: system healthy, product useful, report current/available, and all declared core asset classes represented
overall_aggregation.degraded: system and product are each non-unusable but at least one is degraded, report is partial/stale, regime is justified unavailable, or a declared core class is missing
overall_aggregation.unusable: system health or product usefulness is unusable
